title: CALMER LEFT FEED
why: The critic on the raid screen (10-19): the left toasts are faint and carry explaining sentences. Details over four words stay out of the feed line and old lines dim to 60 percent, not 35.
now: Left feed lines are short names and older lines stay readable.

edits.replacement: if(sub&&sub.split(/\s+/).length<=4) segs.push({t:'  \u00b7  '+sub,c:HUDC.dim});   // v28.xx (cw-feedcalm), the critic (2026-10-19): 'explaining sentences' in the left feed. A detail of five words or more (limited visibility due to fog, kill it for the hoard) stays out of the feed line; the headline is the line.
